capacity_assignments_active_period_check.name: capacity_assignments_active_period_check
capacity_assignments_active_period_check.value: ("capacity_assignments"."status" = 'active' AND "capacity_assignments"."ends_at" IS NULL) OR ("capacity_assignments"."status" IN ('ended','cancelled') AND "capacity_assignments"."ends_at" IS NOT NULL)

capacity_reservations_state_check.name: capacity_reservations_state_check
capacity_reservations_state_check.value:
(
        "capacity_reservations"."status" = 'active'
        AND "capacity_reservations"."cancelled_by_user_id" IS NULL
        AND "capacity_reservations"."cancelled_at" IS NULL
        AND "capacity_reservations"."cancel_reason" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "capacity_reservations"."status" = 'cancelled'
        AND "capacity_reservations"."cancelled_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "capacity_reservations"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND length(trim(coalesce("capacity_reservations"."cancel_reason", ''))) > 0
      )

capacity_assets_dimensions_check.name: capacity_assets_dimensions_check

capacity_assets_owner_check.name: capacity_assets_owner_check
capacity_assets_owner_check.value: "capacity_assets"."carrier_party_id" IS NOT NULL OR "capacity_assets"."owner_party_id" IS NOT NULL OR length(trim(coalesce("capacity_assets"."owner_name", ''))) >= 3

drivers_status_reason_check.name: drivers_status_reason_check
drivers_status_reason_check.value: ("drivers"."registration_status" NOT IN ('blocked','inactive') AND "drivers"."operational_status" <> 'blocked') OR "drivers"."status_reason" IS NOT NULL

transport_request_cargo_profiles_dimensi.name: transport_request_cargo_profiles_dimensions_check

transport_request_commercial_terms_appro.name: transport_request_commercial_terms_approval_check
transport_request_commercial_terms_appro.value: "transport_request_commercial_terms"."status" <> 'approved' OR ("transport_request_commercial_terms"."approved_by_user_id" is not null AND "transport_request_commercial_terms"."approved_at" is not null)

business_party_contacts_channel_check.name: business_party_contacts_channel_check
business_party_contacts_channel_check.value: "business_party_contacts"."email" is not null OR "business_party_contacts"."phone" is not null OR "business_party_contacts"."whatsapp" is not null

freight_proposals_parent_kind_check.name: freight_proposals_parent_kind_check
freight_proposals_parent_kind_check.value: ("freight_proposals"."kind" = 'proposal' AND "freight_proposals"."parent_proposal_id" IS NULL) OR ("freight_proposals"."kind" = 'counterproposal' AND "freight_proposals"."parent_proposal_id" IS NOT NULL)

cities_coordinates_pair_check.name: cities_coordinates_pair_check
cities_coordinates_pair_check.value: ("cities"."latitude" IS NULL AND "cities"."longitude" IS NULL) OR ("cities"."latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "cities"."longitude" IS NOT NULL)

transport_contracts_state_check.name: transport_contracts_state_check
transport_contracts_state_check.value:
(
        "transport_contracts"."status" = 'confirmed'
        AND "transport_contracts"."confirmed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "transport_contracts"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "transport_contracts"."refused_by_user_id" IS NULL
        AND "transport_contracts"."refused_at" IS NULL
        AND "transport_contracts"."refusal_reason" IS NULL
        AND "transport_contracts"."cancelled_by_user_id" IS NULL
        AND "transport_contracts"."cancelled_at" IS NULL
        AND "transport_contracts"."cancel_reason" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "transport_contracts"."status" = 'refused'
        AND "transport_contracts"."confirmed_by_user_id" IS NULL
        AND "transport_contracts"."confirmed_at" IS NULL
        AND "transport_contracts"."refused_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "transport_contracts"."refused_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND length(trim(coalesce("transport_contracts"."refusal_reason", ''))) > 0
        AND "transport_contracts"."cancelled_by_user_id" IS NULL
        AND "transport_contracts"."cancelled_at" IS NULL
        AND "transport_contracts"."cancel_reason" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "transport_contracts"."status" = 'cancelled'
        AND "transport_contracts"."confirmed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "transport_contracts"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "transport_contracts"."refused_by_user_id" IS NULL
        AND "transport_contracts"."refused_at" IS NULL
        AND "transport_contracts"."refusal_reason" IS NULL
        AND "transport_contracts"."cancelled_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "transport_contracts"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND length(trim(coalesce("transport_contracts"."cancel_reason", ''))) > 0
      )
